scope: 7x7x8 analytic native simulator adversaries; no patient execution or optimizer gradients
source_hold: Implementation owner held the final numerical module stable during the independent12-test run

static_findings_repaired.finding: A valid native cut outside the wrapper could be absent from subsequent totals.
static_findings_repaired.fix: Chain each public operation to the last authenticated state; close on drift and expose explicit incomplete-count lower bounds.

static_findings_repaired.finding: Invalid reset could relabel an earlier completed episode as reset_failed.
static_findings_repaired.fix: Preserve prior completion and record the failed reset separately.

static_findings_repaired.finding: Strong ownership of all wrappers retained every full simulator volume across episodes.
static_findings_repaired.fix: Weak live-raw reuse tracking plus monotonically increasing instance IDs.

static_findings_repaired.finding: Malformed reported transition metadata could discard a separately verifiable real commit from known totals.
static_findings_repaired.fix: Authenticate native state first; retain actual commit/reward before validating reported info/reward; mismatch closes without claiming return.

other_verified_boundaries: Constructor has no declared world role; STOP is a returned transition with zero native commits
Actual postcommit interruption retains durable history/reward and original exception
Forged and stale commit exceptions do not invent or duplicate native cuts
Known precommit cancellation remains zero executed work
Receipt-write failure preserves old durable bytes and in-memory failed receipt
Postcommit cancellation plus full-disk failure preserves the original exception and actual commit
Accounting never authorizes a candidate or promises resume

retained_test_history.interpretation: Independent assertion compared durable JSON lists against raw coordinate tuples; real transition counts passed. Test-only canonical serialization fix, no production failure.

limitations: No patient throughput or memory benchmark
Weakref test checks object lifetime, not a measured clinical-case RSS reduction
Separate accounting does not rewrite generic learner counters or support resume
Clinical safety and independent geometry are not established by accounting
